external_url.description: Where a browser reaches this deployment, e.g. https://crewlet.example.com, and where a vendor does too unless api.public names its own. Required once this node serves the API: a port and the ingress role.

host.description: Bind address for the HTTP surface.

port.description: Bind port of this node's HTTP listener: the whole API with the ingress role (less the routes api.public moves to its own listener), only /health and /ready without it (and a seats node's agent-mode tool bridge, where api.public is unset). 0 binds nothing.

trusted_proxies.description: CIDR blocks whose X-Forwarded-For is honoured. Empty trusts no forwarded header.

external_url.description: Where browsers reach artifacts: https://{artifact}.artifacts.example.net for an origin per artifact (wildcard DNS and TLS), or a plain origin such as https://artifacts.example.com for one opaque origin. Required once port is set on an ingress node.

host.description: Bind address for the artifact listener. Empty binds every interface.

port.description: Bind port for the artifact listener, which serves artifact bytes and nothing else; 0 serves none on this node. Ingress nodes only.

changes.description: How long a grant, status or credential change is kept (default 9600h = 400d, 2160h..24000h).

sessions.description: How long a sign-in, step-up and sign-out is kept (default 2160h = 90d, 168h..9600h).

accept_insecure.description: Acknowledge an insecure posture on a routable address. Logged at WARN on every start.

admin.description: Whether this node grants admin to those who hold it (serve), or clamps admin away and keeps every app (refuse). Required once the API is served.

allowed_origins.description: Additional browser origins this deployment is reached on. Empty = same-origin only.

company_writers.description: Ids of the Tier A tokens that alone may change the company document. Empty = whoever the authority table admits.

min_password_length.description: Minimum password length. 0 takes the engine's floor of 12.

tokens.description: The deployment's machine credentials. At least one is required once the API is served.

totp.description: Whether a second factor is required of a person signing in with a password (default required). optional off loopback needs accept_insecure.

external_url.description: Where vendors and remote sandboxes reach this listener, e.g. https://hooks.example.com. Required once port is set on an ingress node.

host.description: Bind address for the public listener. Empty binds every interface.

port.description: Bind port for the dedicated public listener serving only /webhooks/, /otlp/ and /mcp/; 0 keeps every route on api.port.

absolute.description: Longest a session may live from sign-in (default 168h, 1h..720h).

step_up.description: How long a proof of identity authorises a step-up gesture (default 1h, 5m..24h).

grants.description: What this credential may do: admin, tracker, knowledge, artifacts. Required and non-empty.

id.description: Short label; the token acts under the login token:<id>, which is recorded as the author of its writes. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, optionally joined by colons, at most 58 characters so the login stays within 64.

artifacts.description: Artifacts the company may hold, trashed ones included until purged; default 50000, 100..10000000.

company_bytes.description: Bytes every artifact's retained versions and assets may name, each distinct object counted once; default 10 GiB, 1 GiB..16 TiB.

data_bytes.description: Datastore footprint every store together may hold on each data node; default 1 GiB, 64 MiB..1 TiB.

data_store_bytes.description: Datastore footprint one artifact's store may hold; default 32 MiB, 1 MiB..1 GiB.

pending_bytes.description: Bytes one principal may hold reserved for uploads not yet published; default 512 MiB, 64 MiB..16 GiB. A company may hold four times it.

lease_ttl_seconds.description: Seat and presence lease TTL; 0 takes the measured default. Every other lease — a fleet duty, a tracker walk's claim — sizes its own.

type.description: local (single node, default) or embedded-kv (a fleet).

cache_dir.description: Where this node keeps its disposable copies of the company's repositories; relative to the store's directory; unset is <store dir>/git. A volume of its own is recommended: its own filesystem with its own space, not a subvolume or dataset drawing on the store's pool. Never backed up (it carries a CACHEDIR.TAG).

cache_max_bytes.description: The cache's byte budget; unset is derived at boot from the room the cache can use: the volume's free space plus what the cache already holds, less what an embedded broker storing its streams on the same volume may still write under its limit (stream.store_max_bytes, or its own derivation), the request spools' allowance and the revision facts' patch spools (512 MiB). Half of that room when the volume also holds the store, the replicated estate, the snapshots or the broker's streams; seven eighths of a volume of its own. Never more, and never raised to a minimum: a volume that leaves no room at all refuses the node's code host, naming what to change.

import_allow_private.description: Let this node's imports and mirrors — pull and push alike, whatever the name says — dial a host that resolves to a loopback, link-local, private or otherwise non-public address, such as a forge on this node's own network. Off, a host any of whose addresses is not on the public internet is refused before git runs. A proxy the process names (HTTPS_PROXY, NO_PROXY) is dialed either way, and resolves the host itself.

max_checks.description: Checks this node runs at once in container cells — each a container on this machine running a repository's build or tests; unset is a quarter of the node's cores (GOMAXPROCS), at least one; 0 is none, leaving the company's container checks to its other git nodes. A remote (e2b) check runs elsewhere and is not counted.

max_processes.description: Git processes this node runs at once to answer reads, one core each, and half as many again for its caches' background maintenance; 0 is GOMAXPROCS.

max_transfers.description: Clones, fetches and pushes this node serves at once; 0 is four for each of max_processes, and no more than one for every 512 MiB of the node's memory. Each holds a few hundred MiB while it runs, so size it to memory rather than cores.

format.description: Shape written to the file. Empty follows logging.format; set json when a shipper reads it.

level.description: How loud the file is. Empty follows logging.level.

max_backups.description: Rotated files kept beside the live one. Unset = 5; 0 keeps none. Each rotation renames every file it keeps, so the count is bounded.

max_size_mb.description: Size the live file reaches before rotating. Unset = 100. Rotation cannot be disabled, and the cap is bounded above because the byte arithmetic wraps.

path.description: Log file written in addition to stderr. Empty writes no file. Missing directories are created.

format.description: console (default, columns and colour for a person), text (slog key=value) or json (for a log shipper).

stderr.description: Whether the ordinary log stream reaches stderr. Unset = true. false needs logging.file.path, and never silences a boot failure or the watchdog's exit notice.

ca.description: Path to a PEM CA bundle for the server certificate; empty uses the host roots.

cert.description: Path to the client certificate PEM, for a server requiring mutual TLS. Needs key.

key.description: Path to the client private key PEM. Needs cert.

id.description: Stable identity of this process. Empty reads CREWLET_NODE_ID, then defaults to node-0.

labels.description: Free-form node facts a seat's placement selector matches on.

max_concurrent.description: Agent turns this process runs at once; 0 takes the engine default. Per node, so a fleet's ceiling is N times this.

roles.description: What this node does: data, git, ingress, seats, workers. Omit for all five. A node without data keeps no durable state and needs store.scratch; it joins an embedded fleet as a leaf, through stream.leaf.urls, and runs neither ingress nor workers. git needs ingress.

access_key_id.description: Access key id, as a ${VAR} reference; with secret_access_key, or neither to use the environment or the instance's role.

endpoint.description: The S3 API's base URL; empty is Amazon S3's own for the region.

path_style.description: Address the bucket in the path rather than the host name; MinIO and most self-hosted gateways need it.

prefix.description: Prepended to every object's key, e.g. acme/. Companies sharing a bucket are isolated only by credentials scoped to their own prefix.

region.description: The bucket's region; required (R2: auto, MinIO: us-east-1).

secret_access_key.description: Secret access key, as a ${VAR} reference.

backup_owner.description: Who owns this deployment's backups — a person, a team, a scheduler. Warned about when unset.

id.description: Stable key id, colon-free so the envelope parses.

material.description: base64(32 bytes), or a ${VAR} reference to it.

keys.description: The keyring; several entries support online rotation. Required on every node; an embedded fleet's broker credentials are derived from it beside everything else it signs.

busy_timeout_seconds.description: Lock wait before a write gives up, whether it waits in the driver or in the store's own queue, and the anchor for the one retry it then gets; 0 takes the store default.

max_open_conns.description: Ordinary readers of the node's database pool, and of the replicated estate's (at least two there); the identity reserve and one pinned writer per log are added on top. 0 takes the store default, max(8, GOMAXPROCS).

path.description: Local database file this node owns exclusively.

replicated_path.description: Where the replicated estate's database file lives; empty puts it beside path.

scratch.description: Delete this node's store at every boot. Required on a node without the data role, refused on one with it.

snapshot_dir.description: Where this node keeps snapshots of the replicated estate; empty is <dir of path>/snapshots.

backend.description: Where the company's files are kept: nats (the default — a bucket on the fleet's own broker, replicated at stream.replicas) or s3 (an S3-compatible bucket, named under s3).

nats_max_bytes.description: Byte reservation of the nats backend's bucket on the broker; unset derives a share of stream.store_max_bytes, 1 GiB..64 TiB. Refused with backend s3.

artifact_data_log_max_bytes.description: Byte ceiling on the artifact datastore's log; unset derives a quarter of the mutation log's ceiling, set or derived, 1 GiB..16 GiB from a volume alone.

artifacts_log_max_bytes.description: Byte ceiling on the artifacts log; unset derives a quarter of the mutation log's ceiling, set or derived, 1 GiB..16 GiB from a volume alone.

code_log_max_bytes.description: Byte ceiling on the code log, the ordered stream a repository's refs, packs and settings move on; unset derives two thirds of the mutation log's ceiling, set or derived, 1 GiB..1 TiB. Reserved whether or not the company hosts code: one that hosts none and is short of broker room sets 1073741824 before the first boot.

credentials.description: Path to a NATS credentials file for an external server. type: nats needs one of credentials, token, tls.cert or a credential in url.

debug.description: Turn on the EMBEDDED broker's own debug logging. Separate from logging.level, which is the engine's; refused for type: nats. Its warnings and errors are never gated by this.

event_retention_hours.description: Event stream retention; 0 takes the queue default.

iam_log_max_bytes.description: Byte ceiling on the identity estate's log; unset takes a flat 512 MiB, 64 MiB..16 GiB.

pages_log_max_bytes.description: Byte ceiling on the knowledge base's log; unset derives a quarter of the mutation log's ceiling, set or derived, 1 GiB..16 GiB from a volume alone.

replicas.description: Copies of every stream and coordination bucket, and of the company's files on the default nats object store, 1..5: 1 solo, 3 in a fleet, and on an embedded cluster at most its members.

store_dir.description: Embedded stream persistence directory. Required on an embedded broker member, solo included: it keeps every state log from boot. Refused on a leaf.

store_max_bytes.description: How much of store_dir's volume the EMBEDDED broker may hold; unset lets it take three quarters of that volume's free space at boot. Divide it when several engines share one filesystem.

sync.description: always (default) fsyncs every write before acknowledging it; a duration (30s) declines the fsync and names the window an acknowledged write may be behind the disk. A duration is refused for type: nats and on a leaf, which have no file store of this node's to configure.

token.description: Bearer token for an external server; ${VAR} supported. type: nats needs one of credentials, token, tls.cert or a credential in url.

tracker_log_max_bytes.description: Byte ceiling on the mutation log; unset derives a quarter of the free space on the volume the streams live on - stream.store_dir where an embedded broker has one, store.path otherwise - clamped to 4 GiB..64 GiB.

tracker_vectors_max_bytes.description: Byte ceiling on the vector changelog, sized for a model change rather than the steady state; unset derives what the mutation log derives from the volume, a quarter of its free space clamped to 4 GiB..64 GiB, whatever tracker_log_max_bytes is set to.

url.description: External NATS URL. Required for nats, refused for embedded.

usage_log_max_bytes.description: Byte ceiling on the usage log, the compacted stream each node's company days replicate on; default 1 GiB, sized for 181 days of a fleet's seats and schedules, 64 MiB..64 GiB.

advertise.description: host:port peers should dial for this member, when it differs from what it binds.

host.description: Interface the route listener binds. Empty binds every interface. The listener admits only members presenting a key derived from secrets.keys; a route's credential and every byte after it cross the network in clear, so bind it to the private network the peers are on.

name.description: Cluster name shared by every member.

peers.description: Route URLs of the OTHER members, e.g. nats://node-b.internal:6222. An entry that is this node's own route (cluster.host and port, or cluster.advertise) or a repeat is not counted as a member.

advertise.description: host:port leaves should dial for this member, when it differs from what it binds.

host.description: Interface the leaf listener binds. Empty binds every interface. A leaf's link is authenticated, not encrypted, so bind it to the private network the leaves are on.

port.description: A member's leaf listener, where the fleet's leaves join. Admits only a leaf whose key is derived from secrets.keys. A member with one is in a fleet, so it needs stream.store_dir.

urls.description: Leaf listeners of the members this node joins as a LEAF - no JetStream, no replica, no vote - e.g. nats-leaf://member-a.internal:7422. Any one that answers will do. Only a node without the data role may be a leaf, and an embedded node without it must be one.

backup_floor.description: Whose word the trim takes for what is backed up: engine (default) or operator.

backup_max_age.description: How stale the newest backup may be before the trim stops (default 24h, 1h..30d).

min_age.description: Age floor no trim may cross (default 7d, 24h..90d).

rejoin_window.description: Budget for a node to become a complete replica (default 30m, 5m..24h).

snapshot_interval.description: How stale a node's newest snapshot may be before it takes another (default 24h, 1h..7d).

allOf.$comment: local coordination cannot serve a fleet: use coordination.type embedded-kv.
a two-node fleet has no coordination quorum: run one node or three or more.
stream.replicas > 1 on an embedded stream that joins no fleet needs peers to replicate to.
an external stream needs a URL to dial.
every node needs secrets.keys: every state-log record is signed under it.
